name: demo-day
title: DEMO DAY
pitch: A casual demolition puzzle for the phone browser. A street of little brick houses, a tee, and a bag of golf balls. Every brick, pane, floor, beam and roof tile is its own piece: find the weak spot, take it out, and watch the rest come down. Damage stays put, so you can take a few shots, close the app, and pick up the same half-wrecked house later.
